description:
Implement has_key_cert_sign(cert: &Certificate) -> Option<bool> that returns whether the keyCertSign bit is set in the KeyUsage extension.

RFC 5280 §4.2.1.3: KeyUsage is a BIT STRING. keyCertSign is bit 5 (counting from MSB of the first byte, index 5). If KeyUsage is absent, the extension places no constraint.

Return semantics:
  None  — KeyUsage extension not present (no constraint; not an error by itself)
  Some(true)  — KeyUsage present and keyCertSign bit is set
  Some(false) — KeyUsage present but keyCertSign bit is NOT set

Usage in §6.1 state machine: when ValidationPolicy::enforce_key_usage is true and an intermediate cert has KeyUsage present with keyCertSign=false, return Error::KeyUsageMissing { index }.

Implementation note: x509-cert may have KeyUsage decoded in x509_cert::ext::pkix::KeyUsage with individual bit accessors. Prefer that.

Note: this function is only meaningful for intermediate and trust anchor certs. Calling it on the leaf is valid but the result is used differently (the leaf's key usage is not checked during path validation, only during the application-level signature operation).
title: pkix-path: KeyUsage extraction (keyCertSign bit)
